name: Cedar + Sage Soy Candle, 8oz Amber Jar
hook: Cedar shavings, fresh-cut sage, and a thread of pine underneath. Dry and green, not sweet -- the smell of a workshop door left open in fall.
story: This was the first scent I poured that felt finished. I grew up around cut cedar and sagebrush, and every candle before this one was me trying to get back to that smell. This one got there. Hand-poured in small batches -- soy wax, cotton wick, no dyes.
details: Scent: cedar, sage, a little pine
Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance
Amber glass jar with bamboo lid -- reusable when empty
care: First burn: let the melt pool reach the edge (about 2 hours) to prevent tunneling
Trim the wick to 1/4 inch before each burn
Never leave a burning candle unattended
